description: Lexical candidate bindings; a text match is not proof of a runtime binding or completeness. Dynamic candidates require manual inspection. Add-on packaging is excluded from adoption scope.
absence_searches: Searches cover literal identifier tokens in the listed source-file inventories; indirect or dynamically constructed uses remain unresolved.
known_scope: Gateway, HA integration, virtual device, Matter binding, explorer, eBUS, Modbus, tinyebus and add-on snapshots searched; classify actual bindings before adoption.

adoption_contract.scope: Non-runtime consumer obligation for the supported CAN field map; no alias, duplicate field, fallback or migration step.

gateway.obligation: Re-pin the library and validate native field-map passthrough, configuration, CLI, composition, provider and semantic metrics together. Preserve eBUS MCP method compatibility and GraphQL value-field parity. No exact historical field key occurs in the inspected consumer source.

ha-integration.obligation: No direct key match. Explicit SemReg record selection and sensor projections do not consume the native extrema map; validate generic passthrough and schema consumers in the coordinated wave.

ebus-vdev.obligation: No direct key match. Zone temperature/humidity and typed configuration do not consume the native extrema map; validate schema and generic consumers in the coordinated wave.

matterreg.obligation: Review family coverage correspondence; a lexical match does not establish identical native identity.

vrc-explorer.obligation: Review documentary register correspondence; do not equate eBUS identities with CAN quantities.

adoption_contract.release_evidence: Class S: renew affected security, hardware and candidate evidence before release; synthetic comparisons establish no qualification.
